2608.06202.title: What Current AI Benchmarks Leave Unmeasured: Modality, Search, Citations, and Implications (for Safety Evaluations)
2608.06202.paper_summary: Large language model (LLM) benchmark evaluations are routinely used to support claims about model safety, reliability, and deployment readiness. Yet most evaluations rely on a single access modality (model APIs), perform a single run per prompt, and report accuracy as the primary outcome metric, without accounting for conditions such as web search that may have effects on model behavior in deployment. We audit these assumptions for one of the most widely-used LLMs, comparing two modalities, ChatGPT's chat UI and OpenAI's API, with and without web search enabled. We use a stratified total sample of 401 prompts from two popular benchmarks, BBQ and SafetyBench, collecting 4,812 total responses across three repeated runs per prompt. Beyond standard performance measures, we evaluate model output dimensions including response consistency, response text similarity, citation grounding, and abstention behavior. For instance, chat UI responses were less accurate than API responses on both benchmarks with search disabled. Enabling web search reduced accuracy by up to 8 percentage points, and even reversed the direction of modality performance trends for one benchmark. Repeated runs of the same prompt produced inconsistent responses in up to 21\% of prompts. The two modalities also grounded answers in different citations, and abstention behavior was also inconsistent across both modalities. These results illustrate that, even within a model family, reporting only simple accuracy metrics can obscure important forms of model behavioral variation relevant to AI safety assessments. We argue that AI safety evaluations should systematically account for modality, multi-run consistency, search conditions, and response-level behaviors to better reflect how deployed AI systems behave in practice.
2608.06202.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLM）的基準評估通常用於支持有關模型安全性、可靠性和部署準備的主張。<lb/>然而，大多數評估依賴於單一的訪問方式（模型 API），每個提示僅執行一次，並將準確性作為主要結果指標，而未考慮如網頁搜索等可能影響模型在部署中行為的條件。<lb/>我們對其中一個最廣泛使用的 LLM 進行這些假設的審核，並比較了兩種方式，即 ChatGPT 的聊天 UI 和 OpenAI 的 API，並在啟用和未啟用網頁搜索的情況下進行比較。<lb/>我們使用來自兩個流行基準 BBQ 和 SafetyBench 的 401 個提示的分層總樣本，收集了每個提示三次重複運行的 4,812 個總回應。<lb/>除了標準性能指標外，我們還評估了模型輸出維度，包括回應一致性、回應文本相似性、引用基礎和放棄行為。<lb/>例如，在禁用搜索的情況下，聊天 UI 的回應在兩個基準上都不如 API 的回應準確。<lb/>啟用網頁搜索將準確性降低了最多 8 個百分點，甚至在一個基準上逆轉了方式性能趨勢的方向。<lb/>對同一提示的重複運行在多達 21% 的提示中產生了不一致的回應。<lb/>這兩種方式在引用的基礎上也有不同的答案，並且放棄行為在這兩種方式之間也不一致。<lb/>這些結果說明，即使在一個模型家族內，僅報告簡單的準確性指標也可能掩蓋與 AI 安全評估相關的重要模型行為變化形式。<lb/>我們主張，AI 安全評估應系統性地考慮方式、多次運行的一致性、搜索條件和回應層級行為，以更好地反映部署的 AI 系統在實踐中的行為。
